'''Morning Clouds''' is a young [[wolf]] of [[Wildfire]]'s pack.

==Activities==
Morning Clouds, along with [[Two Moons]], Wildfire, [[Old Deer]], [[Half Tail]], [[Rabbit Nose]] and numerous other wolves are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. They scout for him when he is following [[Rand al'Thor]], who was captured by [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|6|54}}
